# PostMail

> PostMail is email tracking software for Gmail and Outlook. It tells you the exact moment a recipient opens your email, and sends real-time notifications so you can follow up while you're top of mind.

PostMail is aimed at salespeople, recruiters, and freelancers who send outbound email and need to know when it's been read.

## What it does
- Detects email opens in real time via an invisible tracking pixel (sub-second detection).
- Filters bot/proxy opens for accurate human-only metrics.
- Sends a Discord webhook notification when an email is opened.
- Works as a Chrome extension inside Gmail compose, and via OAuth for Outlook — no separate app to check.
- Provides a web dashboard with the open history for every tracked email.

## Coming soon
These are planned but not available yet:
- Per-link click tracking.
- Slack webhook and browser push notifications.
- Engagement heatmaps by day and hour, and per-thread engagement graphs.
- A public REST API and Zapier integration.
- AI-recommended follow-up timing.
- SSO/SAML for Enterprise.

## Pricing
- Starter: $0/mo — 50 tracked emails/mo, 1 connected account, basic dashboard, 24h open history.
- Pro: normally $12/mo, currently free while PostMail is in public beta — unlimited tracking, 5 connected accounts, Discord notifications, 30-day analytics. Slack notifications and link click tracking are coming soon.
- Enterprise: custom pricing — dedicated account manager, custom API integrations, SLA, on-premise option. SSO/SAML is coming soon.

## Privacy
Email content never touches PostMail's servers. Tracking pixels are stateless — only the open event is recorded. Connections are encrypted with TLS 1.3.
